Food ok, dearest beer of holiday 70,000 , asked for bill. Hidden extra 8% tax, 5 % service charge. Beer cost increased to 80,000. The worst charge of all 5000 for each wet wipe Really!!!! No napkins on table, so had to use. Don't like being ripped off, not earth shattering money, but sneaky and not pleasant feeling.
